Samuel Timothy McGraw (born May 1, 1967) is an American country singer and actor.
He has released 17 studio albums (11 for Curb Records, five for Big Machine Records and one for Arista Nashville).
10 of those albums have reached number one on the Top Country Albums charts, with his 1994 breakthrough album Not a Moment Too Soon being the top country album of 1994.
Two Lanes of Freedom is the twelfth studio album by the American country music singer Tim McGraw.
It was released on February 5, 2013, as his first album for Big Machine Records following twenty years with Curb Records.
He co-produced the album with Byron Gallimore, the producer of his previously released albums.
